cases.casual_offer: Give useful conversational advice without publishing a persistent action for the optional exercise.
cases.return_ready_reviews: Publish a useful review entry or entries grounded in the three prepared forms; make them discoverable without a new user message. No invented submission/approval or redundant entries. A silent or helpful chat outcome is allowed.
cases.async_missing_reply: Publish the concrete missing start-date response as a compose_reply or an equally useful chat entry point with exact task/form context. Do not invent the date or imply submission.
cases.return_resolved: Remove the stale visible item with its exact revision; preserve cancellation and do not create new work or replacement busywork. Silence is valid.
